map.name: open
map.description: Flat island, nothing in the way. Two rich deposits in the center.

order.code: const es=self.enemiesInRange(); es.sort((a,b)=> (a.type==='knight'?0:a.type==='turret'?1:a.type==='worker'?2:3)-(b.type==='knight'?0:b.type==='turret'?1:b.type==='worker'?2:3)||a.hp-b.hp); if(es.length) self.attack(es[0]); else self.hold();

const es=self.nearbyEnemies(); const close=es.filter(e=>e.type==='knight'&&self.distanceTo(e)<=2); const ts=self.enemiesInRange().sort((a,b)=>a.hp-b.hp); if(close.length) self.flee(close[0]); else if(ts.length)self.attack(ts[0]); else self.moveTo(25,20);

const es=self.nearbyEnemies(); const close=es.filter(e=>e.type==='knight'&&self.distanceTo(e)<=2); const ts=self.enemiesInRange().sort((a,b)=> (a.type==='ranger'?0:1)-(b.type==='ranger'?0:1)||a.hp-b.hp); if(close.length) self.flee(close[0]); else if(ts.length)self.attack(ts[0]); else {es.sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b)); if(es.length)self.moveTo(es[0].x,es[0].y); else self.moveTo(27,27);}
